subject: Final RCA and remediation roster — Lithos Systems production degradation
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@lithos.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Riaz <sana@lithos.com>, EdgeCloud Ops <ops@edgecloud.co>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency/errors impacting Lithos checkout - immediate support needed

David —

We're seeing a sustained spike in p95 latency for the /generate endpoint since ~08:40 PDT and a sharp uptick in 5xx errors that is causing checkouts to fail for some customers. Our SREs captured query traces and some of the traces show repeated KV cache misses and long kernel stalls. This is resulting in timeouts in our payment flow.

Can you confirm whether this is routing to the new quantized variant you deployed last night? We need an ETA on a mitigation or rollback. This is affecting three major merchants.

Attached: query_traces_20260615.zip

--
Alex Torres
Head of Platform Engineering, Lithos Systems
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@lithos.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, EdgeCloud Ops <ops@edgecloud.co>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency/errors impacting Lithos checkout - immediate support needed

Alex —

Thanks for the traces. We see the same signal on our side. Immediate notes:
- A quantized variant (q4_1) was auto-promoted into the service pool at 02:00 UTC during a capacity shuffle last night.
- Early telemetry shows a pattern where sequence-length variance combined with the new kernel path increases stall probability at higher concurrency.

Short term (now):
- We are routing Lithos traffic to the pre-quantized stable model for region-us and throttling concurrent connections from their API key (implemented at 09:30 PDT).
- Karthik and Kimberly are running a targeted KV cache warm and will push a temporary patch to skip a costly path that appears in the trace.

I'll keep you posted with an ETA for rollback verification and a full RCA. Marissa, please own the remediation roster and canary schedule with Lithos PM + SRE.

-David

--
David Kim
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@lithos.com>, Sana Riaz <sana@lithos.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency/errors impacting Lithos checkout - immediate support needed

Quick status update from infra: we've pushed the temporary skip-path patch to the serving runtime on the two affected host pools and triggered KV cache pre-warms for the top 20 routes used by Lithos. Initial error-rate dropped ~70% in the first 20 minutes.

Notes on scope:
- The underlying trigger appears to be a mismatched kernel selection for long sequences at high concurrency when the q4_1 layout is used.
- EdgeCloud's runner showed a small (~6%) increase in token-processing CPU load for q4_1 at steady state under these traces.

Next steps:
- Karthik will snapshot the affected kernel heuristics and open an INF ticket to roll back the q4_1 promotion until we ship a safer kernel selector.
- Marissa, please schedule a 30-minute executive readout tomorrow (16 Jun) to present the full RCA and remediation roster to Lithos and our execs.

-Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Runtime Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@lithos.com>, Sana Riaz <sana@lithos.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, EdgeCloud Ops <ops@edgecloud.co>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Lithos Systems — Final RCA and proposed remediation roster (attached)

Alex / Sana —

Thanks again for the patience while we investigated. Attached is the final RCA (Lithos_Final_RCA.pdf) and the remediation roster (remediation_roster.xlsx) with owners and dates. Executive summary:

- Root cause: a regression in the serving runtime's kernel selection heuristic for the q4_1 quantization path that increases stall probability for variable-length sequences under high concurrent request patterns. The regression surfaced after an internal kernel swap during the May rollout.
- Immediate mitigations performed: failed-variant traffic routed to pre-quantized model, KV cache warm, skip-path patch, throttle policies for the Lithos API key.
- Planned fixes:
  1) Revert auto-promotion of q4_1 until a guarded canary path is added (owner: Karthik, ETA: 2026-06-18).
  2) Add explicit kernel-selection unit tests and add sequence-length markers to telemetry (owner: Kimberly, ETA: 2026-06-22).
  3) Harden prefix/KV cache warm flows and document warm-run SOP (owner: Marissa, ETA: 2026-06-21).
  4) Two-week controlled canary with daily checks and rollback hooks (owner: David, starts 2026-06-20).

We propose a remediation sprint starting 2026-06-18 with daily standups (30m) and a closure checklist on completion. Marissa will share the roster and a link to the sprint board.

Let us know if you'd like additional telemetry or to extend the canary window. I'll be present in the executive readout with Kimberly and Karthik.

Regards,
David

Attachments: Lithos_Final_RCA.pdf, remediation_roster.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@lithos.com>, Sana Riaz <sana@lithos.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec readout scheduled + action tracker link and first sprint standup invite

Alex / Sana —

Thanks everyone for joining the readout earlier. Per commitments in the RCA, I've created the remediation roster and a lightweight action tracker. Links below:
- Sprint board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/RapidBoard.jspa?rapidView=145
- Action tracker (sheet): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2bRcaRemediation

Immediate concrete asks for Lithos:
1) Confirm which merchant accounts you'd like included in the controlled canary (list attached in the sheet).
2) Share any additional high-priority prompts you'd like us to run during the warm-up phase.

Committed owners and short window:
- Kernel selector revert & guarded canary: Karthik Iyer — target 2026-06-18 (in progress).
- Runtime test coverage & telemetry changes: Kimberly Park — target 2026-06-22.
- KV cache SOP & warm-run: Marissa Cole — target 2026-06-21.
- Canary oversight and rollback authority: David Kim — canary start 2026-06-20; rollback immediately if SLOs breach.

I'll run the daily 09:30 PDT standups starting 2026-06-18 and will post concise summaries each day. Expect the first roll-call tomorrow morning.

Thanks — we'll aim to have Lithos fully back to baseline with formal signoff by 2026-06-25.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: remediation_roster.xlsx
